title: Deeper/broader hosted CAD API comparator exclusion
mode: primary-source web research and plan refinement
scope: Screen newly surfaced DWG/DXF comparison candidates for source-visible implementation, local reproducibility, and route lineage
Distinguish a permissively licensed API client from the hosted CAD parser it invokes
Add an explicit no-upload/admission boundary without changing implementation or validation order

method.kind: Read official project SDK repository and service API documentation
method.limitations: The SDK and API documentation describe the public client/service contract, not the hosted parser implementation, its immutable build, or per-entity semantics. No service result was inspected or used as evidence.

sources.observed: The repository identifies itself as an MIT JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for the Cadlens CAD parsing API. Its client methods upload a file, poll a remote job, retrieve structured JSON, and obtain a preview URL. The SDK repository does not contain the DWG/DXF parser implementation.

The service documentation describes authenticated DWG/DXF upload to a hosted REST parse endpoint and remote JSON/preview results. It confirms this is a hosted service route, not a locally inspectable codec.

assessment.planImpact: Classify hosted CAD parse APIs as excluded remote services rather than open-source parser implementations, and prohibit uploading local/customer drawings without explicit authorization and data-handling review. No implementation task or gate was added.

workingTree.reason: This research pass changed only the parity plan and added this research receipt. The shared worktree already contains extensive user changes; other paths were left untouched.
